question.text: In a BARBELL strategy, the portfolio is constructed as:

explanation.text: The Logic: Barbell concentrates at both ends of the duration spectrum with minimal mid-duration. Natural hedge when rate direction is uncertain. The Trap: Bullet strategy concentrates at a single duration; laddered spreads evenly; Barbell is the explicit two-end concentration. Cross-Exam Context: XIII (Derivatives Composite) touches; XXI-B expects grasp of rationale. Manager's Pro-Tip: Barbell outperforms bullet when yield curve twists (non-parallel moves) — it's a curvature play, not a level play.
